## Task Panel System & Audio System — Complete Exploration

I thoroughly explored both systems. Below are the findings with file paths, class structures, key methods, progress tracking, and audio playback mechanisms.

---

### A. TASK PANEL SYSTEM (Two distinct task systems exist)

There are **TWO separate task systems** in this project: an **in-match active task system** (`TaskManager` + `TaskBase`/`KillTask`/`EscortTask`) and a **cross-match meta-quest system** (`QuestTaskManager` + `QuestTaskSO`). Both feed the same UI.

#### 1. `TaskScreen.cs` — `Assets/_Project/Scripts/UI/TaskScreen.cs`
- **Class:** `public class TaskScreen : UIScreen` (namespace `UI`)
- **Role:** HUD-layer popup screen (defaultLayer = `UILayer.HUD`, no mask, no Esc-close). Pops up when a task activates; closes when task ends.
- **Sub-controls (auto-found via `GetComponentInChildren`):** `TaskNotice` (name/countdown/progress), `TaskPreface` (preface text animation), `DirectionIndicator` (target direction arrow).
- **Event subscription:** Registers on `EventChannelLocator.MainContainer.taskUIChannel` in `Awake()` (subscribes immediately, not in OnEnable, since it starts inactive).
- **Handles `TaskUIUpdateData.eventType`:** `ShowNotice` → `Open()` (or `UpdateContent` if already open); `HideNotice` → `Close()`; `UpdateTime` → `taskNotice.UpDateTime()`; `UpdateProgress`/`NoticeData` → `taskNotice.Notice_Data()`; `SetIndicator`/`ClearIndicator` → `directionIndicator`.
- **Lifecycle hooks:** `OnBeforeOpen` fills data from `_pendingData`; `OnAfterOpen` plays `taskPreface.PlayTextAnimation(true)`; `OnBeforeClose` plays slide-out animations.
- **`UpdateContent(data)`** calls `taskNotice.SetInfo(taskName, description, limitTime, requiredCount)` and `taskPreface.SetText(description)`.

#### 2. `TaskNotice.cs` — `Assets/_Project/Scripts/UI/TaskNotice.cs`
- **Class:** `public class TaskNotice : MonoBehaviour` (namespace `UI`)
- **Fields:** 4 `TextMeshProUGUI` — `name`, `description`, `data` (progress), `limitTime`. Plus DOTween anim config (`animationDuration`, `moveDistance`, `easeType`), `CanvasGroup`, `RectTransform`.
- **`SetInfo(name, description, limitTime, requireCount)`** — sets all text; initializes progress to `"{0}/{requireCount}"`.
- **`Notice_Data(string data)`** — updates the progress text (e.g. `"3/7"`).
- **`UpDateTime(string time)`** — updates countdown text.
- **`PlaySlideAnimation(bool slideIn)`** — DOTween Sequence combining position tween + CanvasGroup fade; has an overload with `Action onComplete`.

#### 3. `TaskManager.cs` — `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Managers/TaskManager.cs` (IN-MATCH tasks)
- **Class:** `public class TaskManager : MonoBehaviour` (namespace `Managers`), singleton `Instance` (NOT DontDestroyOnLoad).
- **Role:** Manages **active in-match tasks** (kill/escort) over Photon-style networking.
- **Storage:** `Dictionary<string, TaskBase> tasks`, `HashSet<int> reportedEnemies` (dedup kills), `countdownTime`, `taskRoutine` coroutine.
- **Networking:** Uses `NetworkServiceLocator.ObjectService.InvokeRPC(AppRpcBridge.Instance, "RPC_...", NetworkTarget.All/MasterClient, ...)`. RPC names: `RPC_SetNotice`, `RPC_ActivateKillTask`, `RPC_ActivateEscortTask`, `RPC_ReportCount`, `RPC_UpdateProgress`, `RPC_UpdateAllPlayerTimeUI`, `RPC_TaskFailed`.
- **Channels subscribed:** `taskNoticeChannel`, `enemyReportChannel`, `taskActivationChannel`.
- **Progress tracking (in-match):**

## Task Panel System & Audio System — Complete Exploration

I thoroughly explored both systems. Below are the findings with file paths, class structures, key methods, progress tracking, and audio playback mechanisms.

---

### A. TASK PANEL SYSTEM (Two distinct task systems exist)

There are **TWO separate task systems** in this project: an **in-match active task system** (`TaskManager` + `TaskBase`/`KillTask`/`EscortTask`) and a **cross-match meta-quest system** (`QuestTaskManager` + `QuestTaskSO`). Both feed the same UI.

#### 1. `TaskScreen.cs` — `Assets/_Project/Scripts/UI/TaskScreen.cs`
- **Class:** `public class TaskScreen : UIScreen` (namespace `UI`)
- **Role:** HUD-layer popup screen (defaultLayer = `UILayer.HUD`, no mask, no Esc-close). Pops up when a task activates; closes when task ends.
- **Sub-controls (auto-found via `GetComponentInChildren`):** `TaskNotice` (name/countdown/progress), `TaskPreface` (preface text animation), `DirectionIndicator` (target direction arrow).
- **Event subscription:** Registers on `EventChannelLocator.MainContainer.taskUIChannel` in `Awake()` (subscribes immediately, not in OnEnable, since it starts inactive).
- **Handles `TaskUIUpdateData.eventType`:** `ShowNotice` → `Open()` (or `UpdateContent` if already open); `HideNotice` → `Close()`; `UpdateTime` → `taskNotice.UpDateTime()`; `UpdateProgress`/`NoticeData` → `taskNotice.Notice_Data()`; `SetIndicator`/`ClearIndicator` → `directionIndicator`.
- **Lifecycle hooks:** `OnBeforeOpen` fills data from `_pendingData`; `OnAfterOpen` plays `taskPreface.PlayTextAnimation(true)`; `OnBeforeClose` plays slide-out animations.
- **`UpdateContent(data)`** calls `taskNotice.SetInfo(taskName, description, limitTime, requiredCount)` and `taskPreface.SetText(description)`.

#### 2. `TaskNotice.cs` — `Assets/_Project/Scripts/UI/TaskNotice.cs`
- **Class:** `public class TaskNotice : MonoBehaviour` (namespace `UI`)
- **Fields:** 4 `TextMeshProUGUI` — `name`, `description`, `data` (progress), `limitTime`. Plus DOTween anim config (`animationDuration`, `moveDistance`, `easeType`), `CanvasGroup`, `RectTransform`.
- **`SetInfo(name, description, limitTime, requireCount)`** — sets all text; initializes progress to `"{0}/{requireCount}"`.
- **`Notice_Data(string data)`** — updates the progress text (e.g. `"3/7"`).
- **`UpDateTime(string time)`** — updates countdown text.
- **`PlaySlideAnimation(bool slideIn)`** — DOTween Sequence combining position tween + CanvasGroup fade; has an overload with `Action onComplete`.

#### 3. `TaskManager.cs` — `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Managers/TaskManager.cs` (IN-MATCH tasks)
- **Class:** `public class TaskManager : MonoBehaviour` (namespace `Managers`), singleton `Instance` (NOT DontDestroyOnLoad).
- **Role:** Manages **active in-match tasks** (kill/escort) over Photon-style networking.
- **Storage:** `Dictionary<string, TaskBase> tasks`, `HashSet<int> reportedEnemies` (dedup kills), `countdownTime`, `taskRoutine` coroutine.
- **Networking:** Uses `NetworkServiceLocator.ObjectService.InvokeRPC(AppRpcBridge.Instance, "RPC_...", NetworkTarget.All/MasterClient, ...)`. RPC names: `RPC_SetNotice`, `RPC_ActivateKillTask`, `RPC_ActivateEscortTask`, `RPC_ReportCount`, `RPC_UpdateProgress`, `RPC_UpdateAllPlayerTimeUI`, `RPC_TaskFailed`.
- **Channels subscribed:** `taskNoticeChannel`, `enemyReportChannel`, `taskActivationChannel`.
- **Progress tracking (in-match):**
  - `HandleReportCountRPC` — if kill position within `task.ZoneRadius` of `ZoneCenter`, increments `killTask.CurrentKills` (or `escortTask.currentEscorts`), adds enemyViewID to `reportedEnemies`, and when `>= RequiredKills`/`requiredEscorts` sets `IsCompleted = true`, then RPCs `RPC_UpdateProgress` to all.
  - `HandleUpdateProgressRPC(taskId, count, completed)` — updates the local task, fires `OnTaskUpdated`, calls `Notice_Data($"{count}/{RequiredKills}")`, and if completed fires `OnTaskCompleted`.
- **Completion (`OnTaskCompletedFun` + `DelayReward`):** shows "击杀任务完成！"/"护送任务完成！", then after delay raises `HideNotice`, destroys taskZone, sets `MagicUpgradeManager.instance.isAllExCard = true`, raises `magicUpgradeChannel(true)`, raises `skillQueryChannel` (GetUpgradeExperience) and `experienceChannel`.
- **Countdown:** `TaskRoutine()` decrements `countdownTime` each second, formats `"剩余时间：MM:SS"`, RPCs `RPC_UpdateAllPlayerTimeUI`; on timeout RPCs `RPC_TaskFailed`.

#### 4. `TaskBase.cs` — `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Task/TaskBase.cs`
- **Class:** `[System.Serializable] public class TaskBase` (namespace `Controllers.Task`)
- **Fields:** `string TaskId`, `Vector3 ZoneCenter`, `float ZoneRadius`, `bool IsCompleted`, `int limitTime`.

#### 5. `KillTask.cs` / `EscortTask.cs` — `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Task/`
- **KillTask : TaskBase** — adds `CurrentKills`, `RequiredKills`. Constructor: `KillTask(taskId, zoneCenter, zoneRadius=7, requiredKills, limitTime)`.
- **EscortTask : TaskBase** — adds `currentEscorts`, `requiredEscorts`. Constructor: `EscortTask(taskId, zoneCenter, zoneRadius=4, requiredEscorts, limitTime)`.

#### 6. `QuestTaskManager.cs` — `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Managers/QuestTaskManager.cs` (CROSS-MATCH meta quests)
- **Class:** `public class QuestTaskManager : MonoBehaviour` (namespace `Managers`), singleton `Instance`, DontDestroyOnLoad.
- **Role:** Records meta events during a match, settles when a quest panel opens.
- **Storage:** `Dictionary<int,int> pendingProgress` (in-match cache), `Dictionary<int,int> cumulativeProgress` (saved via `SaveManager`), `QuestTaskDatabaseSO taskDatabase` (loaded from `Resources/QuestTask/QuestTaskDatabase`).
- **Record methods (called by gameplay systems):** `RecordKill()`, `RecordDamage(int damageAmount)` (per 100 dmg), `RecordCoin()`, `RecordExp()`, `RecordMatchComplete()` — each calls `AddProgress(QuestTaskType)` which increments `pendingProgress[taskId]` for every task in the DB matching that type.
- **`SettlePendingProgress()`** — returns `QuestSettleResult` containing `oldProgress` (snapshot before merge) + `delta` (this match's additions); merges pending→cumulative, calls `SaveManager.Instance.SaveGame()`, clears pending. UI uses delta for smooth count-up animation.
- **Persistence:** `GetAllProgress()` / `SetAllProgress(Dictionary)` used by SaveManager for load/save.

#### 7. Task Data ScriptableObjects
- **`QuestTaskSO.cs`** — `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/QuestTask/QuestTaskSO.cs`: `[CreateAssetMenu(menuName="QuestTask/Task Data")] public class QuestTaskSO : ScriptableObject`. Fields: `int taskId`, `string taskDescription`, `Sprite icon`, `QuestTaskType taskType`, `int targetCount`. Enum `QuestTaskType { KillEnemy, DealDamage, CollectCoin, CollectExp, CompleteMatch }`.
- **`QuestTaskDatabaseSO.cs`** — `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/QuestTask/QuestTaskDatabaseSO.cs`: `[CreateAssetMenu(menuName="QuestTask/Task Database")] public class QuestTaskDatabaseSO : ScriptableObject`. Field: `List<QuestTaskSO> allTasks`. Method: `GetTaskById(int id)`.

#### Other UI files (referenced, not deep-read): `TaskPreface.cs` and `DirectionIndicator.cs` in `Assets/_Project/Scripts/UI/`.

---

### B. AUDIO SYSTEM

#### 1. `AudioManager.cs` — `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Managers/AudioManager.cs`
- **Class:** `public class AudioManager : MonoBehaviour` (namespace `Managers`), lazy-load singleton `Instance` (auto-creates `[AudioManager]` GameObject), DontDestroyOnLoad, registered to `ServiceLocator`.
- **Config loaded from Resources (if Inspector unassigned):** `Audio/Config/AudioConfig` (`AudioConfigSO`), `Audio/Libraries/MainSoundLibrary` (`SoundLibrarySO`), `Audio/MainMixer` (`AudioMixer`).
- **Runtime components:** dual BGM `AudioSource` (`_bgmSource`/`_bgmSource2` for crossfade), `_ambientSource`, `_sfxPool` (`AudioSourcePool`), `_mixerController` (`AudioMixerController`).
- **Key playback methods:**
  - **`PlaySFX(string soundId, Vector3? position = null, Transform attachTarget = null)`** — 2D/3D SFX via pool; resolves soundId via `_soundLibrary.TryGetSound`, configures volume/pitch/spatialBlend, plays, then returns source to pool after `clip.length + 0.1s`.
  - **`PlayUI(string soundId)`** — 2D UI sound (spatialBlend=0).
  - **`PlayBGM(string soundId, float? fadeDuration = null)`** — crossfade between dual sources.
  - **`PlayAmbient(string soundId, Vector3? position = null)`** — looping ambient.
  - **`DuckBGM(targetVolume=0.2f, fadeDuration=0.3f)` / `UnduckBGM(fadeDuration=1f)`** — BGM ducking.
- **Volume management:** Master + BGM/SFX/UI/Ambient channels via `AudioMixerController` (or fallback direct `AudioSource.volume`); persisted in PlayerPrefs (`Audio_Master/BGM/SFX/UI/Ambient`).
- **Lifecycle:** Subscribes to `pauseStateChannel` (PauseAll/ResumeAll) and `magicUpgradeChannel` (skips audio pause during card-selection panel via `_skipAudioPause`).
- **`AudioSourcePool` (inner class):** reusable AudioSource array with auto-expand queue; methods `Get/Return/ApplyVolume/PauseAll/ResumeAll/StopAll`.

#### 2. `SoundDefinitionSO.cs` — `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Core/SoundDefinitionSO.cs`
- `[CreateAssetMenu(menuName="Audio/Sound Definition")] public class SoundDefinitionSO : ScriptableObject` (namespace `Core`). Fields: `string soundId`, `AudioClip clip`, `AudioChannelType audioType=SFX`, `volume`, `pitch`, `loop`, `spatialBlend`, `minDistance`, `maxDistance`, `usePooling`.

#### 3. `SoundLibrarySO.cs` — `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Core/SoundLibrarySO.cs`
- `[CreateAssetMenu(menuName="Audio/Sound Library")] public class SoundLibrarySO : ScriptableObject` (namespace `Core`). Holds `SoundDefinitionSO[] _sounds`, builds `Dictionary<string,SoundDefinitionSO>` lookup. Methods: `GetSound(string)` (logs error if missing), `TryGetSound(string, out)`.

---

### C. EXPERIENCE BALL PICKUP SOUND (the key answer)

#### `ExperienceBallBase.cs` — `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Item/ExperienceBallBase.cs`
- **Class:** `public class ExperienceBallBase : DropItemBase` (namespace `Controllers.Item`). Also `ExperienceBall_Blue.cs` is a subclass.
- **Fields:** `uint BallId` (assigned by host on spawn, for pickup dedup), `int ExperienceValue`. `Setup(uint id, int value)` initializes via RPC.
- **The pickup handler is the `protected override void OnReachPlayer()` method** (override of `DropItemBase`). The exact audio trigger (line 35):
  ```csharp
  AudioManager.Instance?.PlaySFX("sfx_PickUp", transform.position);
  ```
- **Flow in `OnReachPlayer()`:** (1) plays pickup SFX `"sfx_PickUp"` at the ball's position; (2) raises `experienceChannel` with `ExperienceValue` (local immediate effect for responsiveness); (3) test mode → returns to local pool `PoolConst.ExperienceBall_Blue_Local`; (4) online mode → RPC `RPC_ClaimExpBall` to MasterClient + immediate local pool return (no wait for RPC).

**IMPORTANT FINDING:** There is NO string `"ExperienceBallPickUp"`. The SFX is invoked by the **soundId `"sfx_PickUp"`** (a generic pickup sound), and the connection to "ExperienceBall" is purely that the call originates from `ExperienceBallBase.OnReachPlayer()`. The soundId must exist as a `SoundDefinitionSO` entry in the `MainSoundLibrary` (`Resources/Audio/Libraries/MainSoundLibrary`) for it to play; otherwise `PlaySFX` logs `"未找到 SFX 定义: sfx_PickUp"`.

Other files using PlaySFX: `AttackRange_WizardBoy.cs`, `GuiLingBase.cs`, `ImpactCannon.cs`, `PowerUpEffectBase.cs` (all in `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/`).

---

### Summary of how task progress flows end-to-end
1. **In-match tasks:** `TaskManager` activates a `KillTask`/`EscortTask` → RPC to all → `TaskScreen` opens via `taskUIChannel.ShowNotice` → `TaskNotice.SetInfo` shows `"0/{RequiredKills}"` → on each kill/escort `HandleReportCountRPC` increments `CurrentKills` → RPC `RPC_UpdateProgress` → `HandleUpdateProgressRPC` → `Notice_Data("{count}/{RequiredKills}")` updates the text → on completion `OnTaskCompletedFun` fires rewards.
2. **Cross-match quests:** gameplay calls `QuestTaskManager.RecordKill/RecordExp/etc.` → increments `pendingProgress` → when quest panel opens, `SettlePendingProgress()` merges into `cumulativeProgress`, saves, returns delta for UI count-up animation.
